title: Moving messages around in local folders when using POP
creator: h.e.neumann
content:
I want to move email messages around in local folders, but "move" doesn't show even when enabled in settings when the account is POP3

However when using IMAP it is worse as the App keeps messing not only with the server messages an folders, but also with other devices.

title: Notification of incoming email works for one provider but not the other.
creator: shadeda1
content:
I recently installed the Thunderbird app on my Samsung S25. I use two email providers - hotmail.com and comcast.net. Thunderbird gives incoming email notifications for my hotmail address but not for comcast.

One of the posts I saw said to make sure the app runs in the background and there are no battery restrictions. Mine was already running in the background and I removed battery restrictions. That did not solve the problem.
